ios.desc:
Connect dots, relax with fun puzzle games, collect hidden objects, play exciting mini-games, and adventure through the universe with Two Dots: a premium brain puzzle game experience that will connect you to endless fun. Whether you want to turn your brain off to unwind or turn your brain on to solve challenging levels, that depends on the puzzle! Join millions of players who have already discovered the soothing joy of connecting colors.

Join two brave dots on their epic, fun adventure as they explore mysterious landscapes, flow through a wide variety of puzzle games, and collect hidden treasures in the beautiful world of Two Dots. Enjoy relaxing music and soothing sound effects as you carefully connect a line, or form a square! and let your brain soak up the vibrant colors. Connect with friends to share your fun adventures, compare games, and line up your hard-earned trophies. Alternatively, just relax on your own while you train your brain with solo puzzle challenges. Some limited-time events in Two Dots, like our incredibly popular Scavenger Hunt, are world-famous for their beautiful, intricate art. 

Form a line and try to make a square to defeat brain-teasing puzzles, or find hidden objects carefully tucked away within the delightfully detailed Scavenger Hunt maps. Remember, making one single square clears all dots of that color and could connect you directly to victory! 

Two Dots offers multiple fun puzzles and mini-games to keep your mind sharp and entertained. Explore the expansive Scavenger Hunt or beat the clock in the Arcade. Connect every color in the Flip mode, have fun hunting for rewards in the Treasure Hunt, and even replay the classic, original Two Dots events with our Rewind puzzles! You'll collect stunning objects and badges from your Two Dots puzzles and games in all colors of the rainbow. If you're ever stuck in your Two Dots game, save some stress and blast through the board with an awesome Power-Up!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE TWO DOTS
● FREE to play: Two Dots puzzle games are fun and completely FREE to play! Zero cost to connect and enjoy.
● ADVENTURE through over 5000 relaxing puzzle levels: Connect dots in a line or a square to win a level. Satisfy your brain with consistently updated, relaxing, and fun puzzle games.
● ENJOY hallmark art: Dive into fun puzzle games featuring Two Dots' beautiful, minimalist art style, including the legendary, highly detailed Scavenger Hunt. 
● PUZZLES, PUZZLES, PUZZLES: Connect with 5 distinct fun game modes

Location: New York City

Remote: Preferred, but open to the right opportunity (particularly in NYC)

Willing to relocate: Maybe

Technologies: Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, Node/JS, AWS (many services), Solidity/Truffle for ETH blockchain stuff. Capable on the frontend too. Design and animation chops (Figma/Jitter). Experience in games, video, audio, fintech, and crypto/NFTs.

Resume: https://po.studio/s/paul_osetinsky_resume_2023.pdf

Email: p dot osetinsky at gmail

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/osetinsky/

I'm a creative hacker with significant experience on the server/devops side. Currently in the process of winding down a fintech/tax startup where I was CTO. Before that, I wrote generative algorithms and smart contracts for this NFT project, which was a great learning experience: https://opensea.io/collection/1989-sisters

A couple fun things I've worked on recently:

* https://lexiplay.com/ | https://riddler.game – word games that use agentic AI systems and meta-prompting to create and moderate their own content. Still needs some work. I used to manage the backend team at Dots and explored puzzle generation there with GANs: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/two-dots-brain-puzzle-games/id880178264

* real-time audio synthesis, streaming, and manipulation with SuperCollider: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iEC6-pBFj2Q

I'm looking for a backend/fullstack role that would let me explore utilizing systems of AI agents to solve interesting problems and create compelling media.

quotes.text:
Hi folks, long time lurker.

I had developed few minimal puzzles games using Unity 3D (back in those days it was called that) during my graduation years and really enjoyed what little I was able to produce with what little knowledge I had. They were nothing fancy, just flat translation/rotation/scale based animated games. Since then life happened and I switched to a full-time android role working on native app development.

I am really interested in getting back to game development (android/iOS) and wanted to hear from folks on how to go about engine/tools to use. Some of my main criteria/concerns are:

  1. Performance/Smoothness: Should feel like native components (60FPS) and easy to develop native-like UI components.
  2. Build size: Should not have a lot of bloat and produce builds that have size similar to native counterparts. 
  3. Basic 3rd party plugin support: Should support commons ad network, IAP, analytics, storage framework, etc.

My evaluation of current candidates

  1. React Native: Cross platform, native like performance, tons of existing JS packages to use from. 
  2. Flutter: Cross platform, native like performance. But don't think the current ecosystem for library has lots of options.
  3. Godot: Cross platform, heavily supported, easy to extend. But seems like an overkill for use-case, also produces build with more than native counterpart size.
